title: Regional incident command
subtitle: Three regions → signature counts → incident brief
source:
define a program named frequency_row
  accept path as text
  accept pattern as text
  accept report as text
  read path
  then "grep" with arguments ["-F", "--", pattern] and keep status as matched
  then count lines
  then parse json as observed
  take integer at "" from observed as count
  run "printf" with arguments ["%d | %s\n", count, pattern]
  then save to report

# Merge real regional evidence, group signatures, and publish an incident brief.
define a program named count_matches
  accept path as text
  accept pattern as text
  accept report as text
  read path
  then "grep" with arguments ["-F", "--", pattern] and keep status as matched
  then save to report
  then count lines
  then parse json as measured
  take integer at "" from measured as count
  then encode count as json

run "cat" with arguments ["incident-us-east.log", "incident-eu-west.log", "incident-ap-south.log"]
then save to "incident-all.log"
read "incident-all.log"
then count lines
then parse json as events_json
take integer at "" from events_json as events
run program count_matches with path "incident-all.log" and pattern "ERROR" and report "incident-error-events.log"
then parse json as errors_json
take integer at "" from errors_json as errors
run program count_matches with path "incident-all.log" and pattern "WARN" and report "incident-warning-events.log"
then parse json as warnings_json
take integer at "" from warnings_json as warnings
read "incident-error-events.log"
then sort
pipe to "uniq" as error_signatures
then save to "incident-errors.txt"
read "incident-warning-events.log"
then sort
pipe to "uniq" as warning_signatures
then save to "incident-warnings.txt"
if errors is 0
  run "printf" with arguments ["CLEAR"] as state
otherwise
  run "printf" with arguments ["REVIEW REQUIRED"] as state
run "printf" with arguments ["{\"title\":\"Regional incident command\",\"status\":\"%s\",\"metrics\":[{\"label\":\"Events scanned\",\"value\":%d},{\"label\":\"Error events\",\"value\":%d},{\"label\":\"Warning events\",\"value\":%d}],\"notes\":[\"Counts come from three regional logs.\",\"Repeated signatures are grouped in incident-errors.txt.\"]}\n", state, events, errors, warnings]
then save to "incident-dashboard.json"
read "incident-regions.json"
then parse json as region_catalog
take list of text at "" from region_catalog as regions
for each region in regions
  run "printf" with arguments ["incident-region-%s.txt", region] as report_path
  run program frequency_row with path "incident-all.log" and pattern region and report report_path
run "cat" with arguments ["incident-region-us-east.txt", "incident-region-eu-west.txt", "incident-region-ap-south.txt"] as regional_frequencies
then save to "incident-regions.txt"
run "printf" with arguments ["╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n║  REGIONAL INCIDENT COMMAND                               ║\n╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n\nSTATE       %s\nCOVERAGE    us-east · eu-west · ap-south\nSCANNED     %d events\nERRORS      %d events\nWARNINGS    %d events\n\nREGIONAL EVENT FREQUENCIES · count | region\n%s\nUNIQUE ERROR SIGNATURES\n%s\nUNIQUE WARNING SIGNATURES\n%s\nARTIFACTS\n  incident-all.log       merged evidence, original order\n  incident-errors.txt    distinct error signatures\n  incident-regions.txt   exact regional event counts\n  incident-warnings.txt  distinct warning signatures\n  incident-dashboard.json  derived dashboard\n\nNEXT MOVE   Edit a regional log, run again, inspect the delta.\n", state, events, errors, warnings, regional_frequencies, error_signatures, warning_signatures]
then save to "incident-brief.txt"

title: Release launch control
subtitle: Typed gates → regional plans → a launch decision
source:
# A failing release stays held; all regional plans are still reviewable.
define a program named regional_checklist
  accept plan as text
  accept version as text
  accept decision as text
  accept passed as integer
  accept failed as integer
  accept canary as integer
  run "printf" with arguments ["REGIONAL ROLLOUT CHECKLIST\nArtifact: %s\nCandidate: %s\nDecision: %s\nTests passed: %d\nTests failed: %d\nCanary allocation: %d percent\n\n1. Confirm regional owner and rollback contact.\n2. Verify the test gate before changing traffic.\n3. Start with the declared canary allocation.\n4. Observe errors and latency before promotion.\n5. Record the final decision in the release review.\n", plan, version, decision, passed, failed, canary]
  then save to plan

read "launch-candidate.json"
then parse json as candidate
take text at "/version" from candidate as version
take boolean at "/checks_passed" from candidate as ready
take integer at "/tests_passed" from candidate as passed
take integer at "/tests_failed" from candidate as failed
take integer at "/canary_percent" from candidate as canary
take list of text at "/plan_files" from candidate as plans
if ready is true
  if failed is 0
    run "printf" with arguments ["READY FOR CANARY"] as decision
    run "printf" with arguments ["Checks passed. Request the regional owner review before a canary."] as guidance
  otherwise
    run "printf" with arguments ["HOLD"] as decision
    run "printf" with arguments ["The gate claims success but failed tests remain. Resolve the inconsistency."] as guidance
otherwise
  run "printf" with arguments ["HOLD"] as decision
  run "printf" with arguments ["Release is blocked until the JSON check gate passes."] as guidance
for each plan in plans
  run program regional_checklist with plan plan and version version and decision decision and passed passed and failed failed and canary canary
then encode plans as json
then save to "rollout-index.json"
read "rollout-index.json" as plan_index
run "printf" with arguments ["{\"title\":\"Release launch control\",\"status\":\"%s\",\"metrics\":[{\"label\":\"Tests passed\",\"value\":%d},{\"label\":\"Tests failed\",\"value\":%d},{\"label\":\"Canary traffic percent\",\"value\":%d}],\"notes\":[\"%s\",\"Regional checklists are generated even while the gate is held.\"]}\n", decision, passed, failed, canary, guidance]
then save to "launch-dashboard.json"
run "printf" with arguments ["╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n║  RELEASE LAUNCH CONTROL                                  ║\n╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n\nCANDIDATE   %s\nDECISION    %s\nTESTS       %d passed / %d failed\nCANARY      %d percent\n\nOPERATOR GUIDANCE\n%s\n\nREGIONAL ARTIFACT INDEX\n%s\n\nHANDOFF PACKAGE\n  rollout-*.txt         one checklist per declared region\n  rollout-index.json    exact generated artifact list\n  launch-dashboard.json  typed release metrics\n  launch-brief.txt      this reviewable launch brief\n\nTRY IT      Fix tests_failed and checks_passed in launch-candidate.json.\n", version, decision, passed, failed, canary, guidance, plan_index]
then save to "launch-brief.txt"
expected:
╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  RELEASE LAUNCH CONTROL                                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

CANDIDATE   2.8.0
DECISION    HOLD
TESTS       846 passed / 3 failed
CANARY      5 percent

OPERATOR GUIDANCE
Release is blocked until the JSON check gate passes.

REGIONAL ARTIFACT INDEX
["rollout-us-east.txt","rollout-eu-west.txt","rollout-ap-south.txt"]

HANDOFF PACKAGE
  rollout-*.txt         one checklist per declared region
  rollout-index.json    exact generated artifact list
  launch-dashboard.json  typed release metrics
  launch-brief.txt      this reviewable launch brief

TRY IT      Fix tests_failed and checks_passed in launch-candidate.json.
hint: In launch-candidate.json, set tests_failed to 0 and checks_passed to true; rerun to change HOLD into READY FOR CANARY.

title: Support signal room
subtitle: A noisy inbox → demand map → on-call handoff
source:
define a program named frequency_row
  accept path as text
  accept pattern as text
  accept report as text
  read path

  then count lines

  take integer at "" from observed as count

  then save to report

read "support-inbox.txt"
then count lines
then parse json as received_json
take integer at "" from received_json as received
run program count_matches with path "support-inbox.txt" and pattern "P1" and report "support-priority.txt"
then parse json as priority_json
take integer at "" from priority_json as priority
run program count_matches with path "support-inbox.txt" and pattern "SECURITY" and report "support-security.txt"
then parse json as security_json
take integer at "" from security_json as security
run program count_matches with path "support-inbox.txt" and pattern "BILLING" and report "support-billing.txt"
then parse json as billing_json
take integer at "" from billing_json as billing
read "support-inbox.txt"
then sort
pipe to "uniq" as demand
then save to "support-demand.txt"
read "support-priority.txt"
then sort
pipe to "uniq" as urgent
then save to "support-urgent.txt"
if priority is 0
  run "printf" with arguments ["ROUTINE"] as state
  run "printf" with arguments ["No P1 requests. Route the demand map into the next planning review."] as action
otherwise
  run "printf" with arguments ["ESCALATE"] as state
  run "printf" with arguments ["Page the on-call owner with support-priority.txt; preserve every original request."] as action
run "printf" with arguments ["{\"title\":\"Support signal room\",\"status\":\"%s\",\"metrics\":[{\"label\":\"Requests received\",\"value\":%d},{\"label\":\"P1 requests\",\"value\":%d},{\"label\":\"Security requests\",\"value\":%d},{\"label\":\"Billing requests\",\"value\":%d}],\"notes\":[\"Repeated requests are counted, not silently discarded.\",\"P1 evidence is saved separately for the on-call handoff.\"]}\n", state, received, priority, security, billing]
then save to "support-dashboard.json"
read "support-categories.json"
then parse json as category_catalog
take list of text at "" from category_catalog as categories
for each category in categories
  run "printf" with arguments ["support-count-%s.txt", category] as report_path
  run program frequency_row with path "support-inbox.txt" and pattern category and report report_path
run "cat" with arguments ["support-count-P1.txt", "support-count-P2.txt", "support-count-P3.txt", "support-count-SECURITY.txt", "support-count-BILLING.txt", "support-count-ACCESS.txt", "support-count-FEEDBACK.txt"] as category_frequencies
then save to "support-categories.txt"
run "printf" with arguments ["╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n║  SUPPORT SIGNAL ROOM                                    ║\n╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n\nQUEUE STATE %s\nRECEIVED    %d requests\nPRIORITY 1  %d requests\nSECURITY    %d requests\nBILLING     %d requests\n\nPRIORITY + CATEGORY FREQUENCIES · count | label\n%s\nON-CALL HANDOFF · distinct priority-one signatures\n%s\nFULL DEMAND MAP · distinct request signatures\n%s\nACTION\n%s\n\nARTIFACTS\n  support-priority.txt   raw urgent requests, original order\n  support-demand.txt     distinct request signatures\n  support-categories.txt  exact per-label frequencies\n  support-urgent.txt     distinct urgent signatures\n  support-dashboard.json  computed queue metrics\n  support-handoff.txt    this operator handoff\n\nTRY IT      Add a P1 line to support-inbox.txt and run again.\n", state, received, priority, security, billing, category_frequencies, urgent, demand, action]
then save to "support-handoff.txt"

title: Find the fires
subtitle: Filter → sort → deduplicate → save
source:
# Turn noisy application logs into an actionable report.
accept severity as text with default "ERROR"
read "app.log"
then grep with pattern severity and flags ["-F"]
pipe to sort
pipe to uniq
then save to "incidents.txt"
expected:
ERROR api timeout
ERROR disk near capacity

expectedFiles.incidents.txt:
ERROR api timeout
ERROR disk near capacity

title: Ship or hold?
subtitle: Typed JSON drives a real branch
source:
# The decision lives here, not in JavaScript.
read "release.json"
then parse json as release
take boolean at "/checks_passed" from release as ready
if ready is true
  run printf with message "Ready for release review"
otherwise
  run printf with message "Hold: checks need attention"
then save to "release-decision.txt"

title: A reusable shortlist
subtitle: Local program + typed arguments + files
source:
# One reusable program, with explicit inputs and local scope.
define a program named shortlist
  accept path as text
  accept limit as integer
  read path
  then sort
  pipe to uniq
  pipe to head with lines limit
accept limit as integer with default 3
run program shortlist with path "people.txt" and limit limit
then save to "shortlist.txt"

title: Keep the good work
subtitle: Run twice. Inspect the cache hit.
source:
# Explicit caching, keyed by input, argv and the virtual filesystem.
accept lines as integer with default 2
read "app.log"
then head with lines lines and cache
expected:
INFO worker ready
ERROR api timeout

title: Failure is data
subtitle: Keep an exit status, choose what happens
source:
# Missing matches are an expected outcome for this report.
read "app.log"
then "grep" with arguments ["-F", "PANIC"] and keep status as found
if found is 1
  run printf with message "No panics. Carry on."
otherwise
  run printf with message "Inspect the panic report"

title: Bring your own bytes
subtitle: Stdin → a real byte pipeline
source:
# Paste newline-separated names into the stdin box below.
read from stdin
then sort
pipe to uniq
then save to "cleaned.txt"

title: A batch of files
subtitle: One text list → native commands for each file
source:
# Sort two virtual files in place. Inputs stay explicit.
accept files as list of text with default ["tasks-one.txt", "tasks-two.txt"]
for each path in files
  read path
  pipe to "sort"
  then save to path
